review:
A green-eyed genie cat wanders an Arabian-nights bazaar on 1,024 ways, with magic lamps and gem-filled reels.

The lamps drive the bonus rounds, and there's a Hold & Win plus several buy options, including a Mystery Buy. Medium-low volatility, a 2,000x max and 97% RTP, with bonuses roughly once every 184 spins. A relaxed, good-value game with a charming theme.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
